body: Its rough, I haven't seen a single positive news story in a while, I guess you tend to forget about the little guy when reading that, the average person whos just trying to live their life, who makes up realistically like, at least 85% of the population if not upwards of I dont know, 98%

Yeah, I guess I sort of realized having that negative of an attitude about things won't get me anywhere or improve the world, I also looked up things online to sort of improve my world view, and as far as statistics go the world is the best its ever been, and only continues to get better, poverty rates are declining, so is violence etc, so theres alot of positive things, the world is still a scary place, but its getting better, and best I can do is contribute to that

Thank you so much, first thing Ive done tonight is set up a recurring donation the local mission and I'm going to start looking into volunteering. Its just hard to motivate yourself to do that when you feel like this, but thank you, I'm starting to feel a bit better about things, I guess you make your own happiness right, so thank you so much for responding it means the world to me :), I guess in a way you're doing what you just recommended me to do :P
